title: Publication Operation Identity and Concurrency-Safe Canonical Ledger Closure
released_boundary: PublicationPreviewExactlyOnceEvidenceBoundary: a preview-only publication application-service evidence boundary that accepts explicit caller-supplied operation identities, persists schema-validated and outcome-complete canonical terminal events exactly once per operation under concurrent fcntl-locked retry, detects and refuses conflicting replays, validates nested receipt evidence digests on reconstruction, and enforces governance-significant field completeness via conditional JSON Schema constraints.
stated_consumer_purpose: T4 timeline reconstruction and later desktop Publish Preview history can consume publication evidence with truthful action history, safe retry behavior, no duplicated or collapsed terminal outcomes, and guaranteed evidence integrity at both event and receipt levels.
dirty_state_before: Pre-existing untracked: .swift-version, docs/json/audits/lane_s3_publication_preview_release.v1.json. No dirty tracked files.
dirty_state_after: Same pre-existing files preserved. No other-lane files absorbed.

schema_validation_results.event_schema: updated — now requires evidence_digest, safety_passed, deployment_ready; conditional allOf for success (requires result_digest as string) and refusal (requires refusal_code+refusal_reasons non-empty array)
schema_validation_results.receipt_schema: updated — now requires evidence_digest, safety_passed, deployment_ready; conditional allOf for success/refusal completeness
schema_validation_results.both_schemas: pass jsonschema self-check and repo validator

completed_work: Moved operation-id deduplication inside fcntl LOCK_EX scope: _find_under_lock() re-reads the ledger under the lock, eliminating the check-before-lock race
Added conflict detection: same operation_id with different receipt governance content raises RuntimeError('idempotency conflict')
Added _verify_receipt_evidence_digest(): recomputes and verifies the receipt's evidence_digest on every append and reconstruction
Added _receipt_governance_digest() for conflict comparison over outcome fields
Rewired compile_preview() to accept explicit caller-supplied operation_id parameter; defaults to fresh UUID v4 when not provided
Removed _build_operation_id() which derived operation identity from deterministic input content (collapsed distinct actions)

Updated event schema: required fields now include evidence_digest, safety_passed, deployment_ready; JSON Schema allOf conditionals require result_digest (non-null string) on success, refusal_code + refusal_reasons (non-empty array) on refusal
Updated receipt schema: same governance completeness constraints as event-level condensed receipt
Added 11 new production-boundary tests: 2 concurrency, 1 conflict, 1 nested digest tamper, 2 schema conditional, 5 upgraded tests
Preserved all T1 and T1.1 repairs: receipt digest binding, preview_only/deployment_ready guard, schema validation, recursive content-light, typed reconstruction, authoritative mode
